use_cases: Hero sections with interactive spotlight following the cursor for engaging landing pages
Card hover effects where a spotlight reveals content or creates depth
Interactive backgrounds for navigation or sidebar elements
Dark mode UI enhancements with subtle glow effects on user interaction
Product showcases with dynamic lighting effects following mouse movement
ai_summary: A spotlight effect component that creates a radial gradient glow following the mouse cursor using spring physics. Built with Framer Motion's useSpring and useTransform for buttery-smooth animations, this component modifies its parent element's positioning to create an immersive hover experience. Ideal for modern dark-themed UIs requiring subtle interactive feedback without being obtrusive.
